Third pre-release of 2.0 — the **Metadata** area with blurb and cover panels and the **Calibre import** are in the new Qt interface. Dictionary, E-reader and Preview still show a note and follow in the next pre-releases; keep using 1.4 for those.

## New

- **Metadata:** form with all fields and your own Calibre columns; differences from Calibre or KOReader are shown below each field, the arrow puts the value in. *Apply*, *Discard*, *From Calibre* and *Complete* (fill gaps from Calibre) as before.
- **Blurb panel:** edit as a draft, *Look up* (one book or all, in the background) and *From Calibre*.
- **Cover panel:** cover in the file and the new one side by side, *From file*, *Look up* with a choice window, all missing covers, *Export*, show large.
- **Import from Calibre library** (*File* menu): tick the changes you want, empty fields only, blurbs, unmatched books.
- *Edit* menu now has the blurb, cover and metadata commands.

## Fixed

- Custom Calibre columns were not read back when the OPF had a self-closing `<meta … />` before them (also in 1.4).

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.0-beta3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
